exams.name: Real Estate Broker Examination
exams.notes: Commission selects and administers; may use independent testing services. Commission may waive examination requirement for applicants licensed in another jurisdiction with substantially equal examination.
exams.quote: has passed an examination as required by the Commission

available.quote: The Commission may waive all or a part of the examination requirement if the applicant is a real estate broker or salesperson regulated under the laws of another jurisdiction, who is in good standing to practice in that jurisdiction and, in the opinion of the Commission, the jurisdiction's examination is substantially equal to that required by this chapter.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicants must have held a broker's or salesperson's license in prior state of residence for two years; must provide a statement from the regulatory body of the other state concerning any criminal or disciplinary investigation or action. Examination may be waived if prior jurisdiction's exam is substantially equal.
requirements.quote: A nonresident of the State, who has held a real estate broker's or salesperson's license in the previous state of residence for a period of two years prior to applying for a license, may be licensed to act in a similar capacity in this State by conforming to the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling money or other property to which clients or other persons are entitled with the licensee's own funds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commingling money or other property to which the licensee's clients or other persons are entitled with the licensee's own, except to the extent nominal sums of the licensee's funds may be required to maintain an open trust account

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform clients, establish trust and escrow accounts, maintain records, and otherwise act in accordance with escrow provisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to inform clients, establish trust and escrow accounts, maintain records, and otherwise act in accordance with the provisions of section 2214 of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing promptly to segregate any properties received that are to be held for the benefit of others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to fully disclose to a buyer all material facts within the licensee's knowledge concerning the property being sold.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: If a brokerage firm maintains more than one place of business within the State, a branch office registration is required for each branch office so maintained.

definition_quote.value: "Real estate broker" or "broker" means any person who, for another, for a fee, commission, salary, or other consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting such compensation from another, engages in or offers or attempts to engage in, either directly or indirectly, by a continuing course of conduct, any of the following acts: (A) lists, offers, attempts, or agrees to list real estate or any interest therein for sale or exchange; (B) sells, exchanges, or purchases real estate or any interest therein; (C) offers to sell, exchange, or purchase real estate or any interest therein; (D) negotiates, or offers, attempts, or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, or purchase of real estate, or any interest therein; (E) buys, sells, offers to buy or sell, or otherwise deals in options on real estate or any interest therein; (F) advertises or holds himself or herself out as being engaged in the business of buying, selling, or exchanging real estate or any interest therein; (G) assists or directs in the procuring of prospects, calculated to result in the sale or exchange of real estate or any interest therein

license_tiers.quote: A license as a real estate broker shall be granted to a person who satisfies all of the following... A license as a real estate salesperson shall be granted to a person who satisfies all of the following

broker_of_record_required.quote: A registered brokerage firm shall designate in its application the individual who is to serve as the principal broker under the brokerage firm registration.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: has completed a course of instruction of at least 40 hours, approved by the Commission.

escrow_account_required.quote: Every real estate broker, within five banking days, shall deposit in a trust or escrow account in a bank or other financial institution licensed to do business in this State all earnest money and contract deposits held by him or her as a real estate broker

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: Every real estate broker, within five banking days, shall deposit in a trust or escrow account

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Trust and escrow accounts shall be maintained separate and apart from a broker's individual or office account.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Branch offices shall use the same registered brokerage firm name as the main office and shall designate a licensed broker in charge for each branch office.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: has been employed by or become associated with a brokerage firm and that firm's principal broker

value: bona fide property owners performing acts with reference to their own property
attorneys at law handling real estate sales in course of estate, guardianship, trust, bankruptcy, receivership, or court proceedings
auctioneers selling real estate at bona fide public auction
banks or trust companies and their officers or employees acting with respect to real estate owned by the bank or trust company
persons holding a duly executed power of attorney from the owner for non-recurrent final consummation of sale, purchase, or exchange
persons acting as receiver, trustee, administrator, executor, guardian, or under court order, deed, trust, or will
public officers while performing their duties
persons who lease real estate or negotiate leases
registered securities dealers or salespersons when selling securities
license_exemptions.quote: The terms "real estate broker," "real estate salesperson," or "broker" shall not include: (1) Any person, partnership, association, or corporation who as a bona fide owner performs any of the acts set forth in subdivision (a)(4) of this section with reference to property owned by them
